messages:
Jules: Mini LAN next Friday at the office? I can bring two desktops, a 16-port gigabit switch, and some surge strips. Anyone up for smash, towerfall, and some co-op roguelikes? :joystick:
Nick: I am SO in. bringing my Switch + dock. need someone with spare joycons?
Emily: Might come by around 7pm. I can bring snacks and a spare monitor.
Omar: Count me in if there's space for one more PC. Also can bring ethernet cables + my old Logitech pad.
Tash: I can bring an extra PS4 controller and a power strip. What time are we aiming for?
Jules: Let's start around 6:30 so people can get set up before dinner. planning to run until ~11pm.
Alex: I can host remote folks via Parsec again. If people want to share Steam libraries, ping me and I'll set up invites.
Emily: Ooh Parsec please. last time was smooth.
Nick: Quick logistics q — do we need to reserve a conference room or is the lounge OK?
Jules: Lounge should be fine (plenty of tables). I'll tape a sign so it doesn't get double-booked.
Omar: FYI office Wi-Fi can be flaky under load. recommend hardwired. I'll label ports on the switch.
Tash: Can someone bring a little ethernet tester? I have one but it's packed away.
Alex: I have a small tester + a roll of Cat6 spare. leaving them by the switch.
Jules: Sweet. Also planning a tiny bracketed tourney for Smash (double elim) and a free-for-all for TowerFall. prizes = snacks and glory.
Nick: :trophy: count me for Smash tourney. seed me low, for drama.
Emily: If anyone wants to sign up to borrow controllers/gear beforehand DM me.
game-night-bot: Reminder: please follow workplace conduct rules while gaming. This event requires no loud music past 10pm.
Omar: Can we do a quick pickup list? I'll add cables and steam invites.
Jules: pickup list: switch, surge strips, cables, 2 PCs, switch config (simple), snacks, spare controllers, Parsec host.
Alex: For Parsec: run `parsec-host start --name "RedwoodLAN-1"` and DM me the host id. I'll stitch the invite links.
Tash: Someone remind me how to share a Steam lib — is it still Family Sharing?
Emily: Yup Family Sharing. Share settings -> authorize device -> then grant. I can walk folks through at setup.
Nick: If the lounge is full, can we overflow into Meeting B? I'll scout and update thread.
Jules: Awesome. I'll post a sign-up grid in #random with names + games so we don't overlap setups.
Omar: One last thing — bringing a little bin for recyclables would be great.
Jules: Good call. OK everyone — RSVP here and I'll lock in final list by Thursday. :party_parrot:
